title: Codebases as Knowledge Graphs: Building the AI-Native Context Layer with Graphify OSS
description:
Large Language Models have revolutionized coding, but forcing AI agents to constantly grep and reread thousands of raw files burns context windows and drives up token costs. Inspired by Andrej Karpathy's vision for the ultimate codebase assistant, **Graphify** is an open-source tool that instantly transforms an entire repository—code, documentation, and configurations—into a locally queryable knowledge graph.

This lightning talk introduces Graphify's architecture, demonstrating how zero-token, local Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) parsing maps out structural dependencies to serve as a fast semantic context layer for tools like Claude Code and Cursor. Discover how this viral open-source project is replacing legacy codebase indexing and setting the new standard for AI-native developer tooling.
